Server API

group GENERIC_PROPERTY_SERVER_API

Function declarations for server-side operations related to generic property models.

Functions

bool generic_user_property_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info)

Register a generic user property server model.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index where the server model is being registered.

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to the generic user property server model context.

Return values:

  • true -- If the registration was successful.

  • false -- If the registration failed, possibly due to an invalid element index or context.

Returns:

Boolean indicating whether the registration was successful.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t generic_user_property_publish(const mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, const generic_property_db_t *pdb)

Publish a generic user property value.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to the server model context.

  • pdb -- [in] Pointer to the generic user property database entry to publish.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- If the message was published successfully.

  • Others -- If there was an error during publishing.

Returns:

Send cause of the message publishing.

void generic_user_property_server_set_db(mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, generic_property_db_t *pproperties, uint16_t num_properties)

Set a user-defined generic user property database.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to the server model context.

  • pproperties -- [in] Pointer to the user-defined generic user property database.

  • num_properties -- [in] Number of properties in the database.
